title: Campaign report week 4

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: It's here! Week four of the funding campaign. Do you want to hear the results?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's here! Week four of the funding campaign. Do you want to hear the results?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Tell me!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: With Clancy's and Reena's help we collected a huge 11,340 Lims - plus what we raised from people's personal donations.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: With Clancy's and Reena's help we collected a huge 11,340 Lims - plus what we raised from people's personal donations.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: With Clancy's help we collected 5670 Lims this week - and a bit extra from other people.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: With Clancy's help we collected 5670 Lims this week - and a bit extra from other people.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Unfortunately you never spoke to Clancy... but thank to Reena we collected 3780 Lims this week. Plus a little extra from direct donations.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Unfortunately you never spoke to Clancy... but thank to Reena we collected 3780 Lims this week. Plus a little extra from direct donations.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: We only collected 1890 Lims this week, plus a little more directly. If Clancy and Reena had... never mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We only collected 1890 Lims this week, plus a little more directly. If Clancy and Reena had... never mind.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I'll send the final campaign balance to your HUD right now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll send the final campaign balance to your HUD right now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text:
Campaign balance: [LochlainnMcKenna.BoyFunding] 
We did it! Ava, we did it!

Not enough... Isn't there anything more we can do?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: We could ask Calhoun for a loan.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We could ask Calhoun for a loan.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Or we take Mary-Nyx Curzona's offer to add the missing amount to your generational debt.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Or we take Mary-Nyx Curzona's offer to add the missing amount to your generational debt.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Or you could make up the missing Lims out of your own pocket. You have enough money to do that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Or you could make up the missing Lims out of your own pocket. You have enough money to do that.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Otherwise, I'm afraid it might be end for poor Iann...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Otherwise, I'm afraid it might be end for poor Iann...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ugh... I'll talk to Calhoun.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm going to have to talk to Mary-Nyx.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm going to have to talk to Mary-Nyx.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm going to have to talk to Mary-Nyx.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm going to have to talk to Mary-Nyx.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No question. I'll make up the difference.

pronounText.TextSheVersion: No question. I'll make up the difference.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No question. I'll make up the difference.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think we're out of options, Ava. I guess I'll... talk to Lochlainn.
